title: Fuzzy Explainable Continual Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2611.20427v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continual robot navigation requires reinforcement learning policies to continuously adapt to new environments while retaining previously acquired knowledge. Meanwhile, explainable reinforcement learning aims to learn meaningful behavioral representations through policy interaction. However, these objectives are inherently conflicting, as continual learning emphasizes policy stability whereas explainable behavior learning requires adaptive exploration. Existing methods rarely address both simultaneously. To resolve this issue, this paper proposes a Fuzzy Explainable Continual Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (FECHRL) method. A two-stage behavior cloning strategy is introduced to balance rapid policy adaptation and explainable behavior evolution by progressively transitioning from strong imitation guidance to autonomous reinforcement learning. translated_title: 面向机器人导航的模糊可解释持续分层强化学习
translated_abstract: 持续的机器人导航要求强化学习策略在不断适应新环境的同时，保留先前已获得的知识。与此同时，可解释强化学习旨在通过策略交互学习有意义的行为表征。然而，这两个目标存在内在冲突：持续学习强调策略的稳定性，而可解释行为学习则需要自适应的探索。现有方法很少同时兼顾这两方面。为解决这一问题，本文提出了一种模糊可解释持续分层强化学习（FECHRL）方法。该方法引入了一种两阶段行为克隆策略，通过从强模仿引导逐步过渡到自主强化学习，来平衡快速策略适应与可解释行为演化。此外，提出了一种基于Takagi–Sugeno模糊推理系统的模糊评论家（critic），以……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出模糊可解释持续分层强化学习方法FECHRL，通过两阶段行为克隆策略实现从模仿引导到自主学习的渐进过渡，并引入基于Takagi–Sugeno模糊推理系统的模糊评论家，从而同时化解机器人导航中持续学习所需的策略稳定性与可解释行为学习所需的自适应探索之间的内在冲突。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FECHRL, a fuzzy explainable continual hierarchical reinforcement learning method for robotic navigation that resolves the inherent conflict between continual learning's emphasis on policy stability and explainable behavior learning's need for adaptive exploration, via a two-stage behavior cloning strategy transitioning from imitation guidance to autonomous reinforcement learning and a Takagi–Sugeno fuzzy inference-based fuzzy critic.
